candidates.M1: age-only linear: r ~ a + b * age_tx
candidates.M2: causal static ridge on the 9 deployable static features
candidates.M3: last-closed residual bias (constant, median residual of the most recent closed pass group)
candidates.M4: EWMA residual bias (constant; alpha 0.05 and 0.2, the better on validation)
candidates.M5: recursive least squares bias/drift on [1, age_h], forgetting 0.99
candidates.M7: ridge on the 9 static + 17 historical-state features

constant_predictor_note: M3 and M4 are constants and remain gate-eligible because a constant offset provisioned at refresh is a deployable corrector. If a constant wins it must be interrogated against the element-chaining audit (R8) BEFORE being reported as learnable structure -- the previous review showed a chained construction manufactures lag-1 dependence that a bias tracker would exploit spuriously.
kalman_R_rule: sample variance of the TRAIN-fold pass-mean residuals
forbidden_models: any model or feature chosen after inspecting deployment results
